{{DISPLAYTITLE:Jelly (''Tactics Advance'')}}
[[File:FFTA-spr-Jelly.gif|left]]
{{Quote|Red, jelly-like entity. Absorbs fire damage.|Description}}
The '''Jelly''' {{J|レッドマシュマロ|Reddomashumaro|Red Marshmallow}} in ''[[Final Fantasy Tactics Advance]]'' is a plasma-like monster that is related to the [[Cream (Tactics Advance)|Cream]] and [[Ice Flan (Tactics Advance)|Ice Flan]]. It follows the [[Flan]] mold of having a huge [[Defense (stat)|Defense]] stat, but being very weak to magical spells. Jelly absorbs [[Fire (element)|Fire]] damage, but can be destroyed easily with nearly any other elemental spell.

{{see|Red Marshmallow}}
